decision: IMPLEMENT the lightweight staged semantic-accountability architecture (Pass A source-only inventory -> Pass B composition with lineage -> Pass C deterministic reconciliation + quantitative reconciliation), WITH the CONTEXT/INDEX/NORMALIZATION remediations the root-cause trace (06) justifies, as ONE additive layer around the existing General Covenant IR and compiler - never a second covenant model.
whyStagedNow: Mission 4 established the blind spot this mission names: when the model never attempts a material component, nothing source-derived exists to notice. The reality check's 8 literal absent-value misses were caught only by the verifier's numeric reconciliation (a post-hoc check with no lineage) or by the LLM reviewer.

The root-cause trace (06) shows the shared-cap loss is multi-factor and NOT a model-capability limit: the model produced the SharedCapacity and cross-unit edges whenever the evidence reached it; the losses are in context anchoring/starvation, reference resolution, normalization's silent drop, and measurement. A source inventory that names SHARED_CAP/DEPENDENCY/REFERENCE components is the mechanism that makes those losses visible instead of silent.

Mission 4's Option-1 decision was made on the premise that the model does not drop material under cardinality; that premise stands (A2's 19 leaves), but it did not address the different failure this mission targets - material components the model never attempts, and quantitative values that vanish between source and IR with no accounting.

principles.notASecondCovenantModel: The inventory is a FLAT list of {inventoryItemId, sourceSpan, semanticRole, proposition, quantitativeValues[], referencedTerms[], referencedSections[], materiality, ambiguity}. It carries no IRExpression/IRRule/IRDefinition/IRCondition/IRException/SharedCapacity shape. The existing IR remains the only composed representation.
principles.passAIsSourceOnly: Pass A receives ONLY source text + resolved source context (Section 12/13 expansion with provenance). It never sees the compiled IR, compiler output, verifier findings, or GT; its module may not import semantic/compile, semantic/normalize, semantic/caller, semantic-verification/*, semantic-precedent/*, or ir/types (enforced by tests/contract-model/semantic-accountability-independence.test.ts).
principles.freezeBeforeCompose: Pass A output is content-hashed (frozenContentHash) before Pass B runs; Pass B receives the frozen inventory read-only.
principles.passBIsAdditive: WireRule/WireDefinition/WireSharedCapacity/WireCondition/WireException/WireExpression gain optional inventoryItemIds[]; the submit schema gains inventoryDispositions[]; IRRule/IRDefinition/IRSharedCapacity/IRCondition/IRException and every IRExpression node gain OPTIONAL inventoryItemIds. No existing field changes meaning; identity.ts's exprId excludes provenance and lineage is placed outside the hashed content (see 04).
principles.passCIsDeterministic: reconciliation.ts classifies every MATERIAL/CRITICAL inventory item as REPRESENTED / INTENTIONALLY_NON_COMPUTATIONAL / UNSUPPORTED / AMBIGUOUS / MISSING_FROM_COMPOSITION from lineage + dispositions + a value-level scan of the final IR; no model decides the final status. Any CRITICAL/MATERIAL MISSING_FROM_COMPOSITION -> failureReason INVENTORY_ITEM_MISSING_FROM_COMPOSITION -> at least REVIEW_REQUIRED (compile.ts's existing determineStatus machinery, never a new status kind).
principles.quantitativeAccounting: A deterministic value scanner (MONEY/PERCENT/RATIO/DAYS/DATE-PERIOD/MULTIPLIER) runs over the source unit as Pass A's own zero-cost layer; every material inventory value must be proven present in the final IR (numeric match by kind) or explicitly dispositioned; a scanner value the model never inventoried is surfaced as UNINVENTORIED_VALUE (REVIEW_UNCERTAIN) - never invisible, never auto-declared material.
principles.attemptedStructureRetained: checkIntraDefinitionComponentCompleteness and IRUnsupportedExpression.attemptedStructure are untouched; they answer 'what did composition attempt before type failure', Pass A/C answers 'what source semantics existed that composition may never have attempted'.
principles.verifierIndependence: semantic-verification/* is NOT modified and does not import semantic-accountability/*; it never consumes Pass A conclusions. Reconciliation evidence is stored on SemanticCompilationResult.accountability for audit and for the agreement-level rollup only.

sourceContextSufficiency: Implemented as a deterministic pre-Pass-A step (source-context.ts): the operative window is checked against the anchoring structural node / definition span boundaries (TRUNCATED_SOURCE when the window ends before the unit's own boundary); explicit cross-references in the operative text are resolved through the structural index with generic prefix normalization, enclosing-node fallback for inline sub-clauses, and degenerate-occurrence exclusion (TOC entries) with full disclosure; each expansion carries documentId/nodeId/sectionRef/charStart/charEnd provenance and is bounded by a per-unit character budget; the resulting state is one of COMPLETE_LOCAL_SOURCE / DEPENDENCY_EXPANDED_SOURCE / TRUNCATED_SOURCE / STRUCTURALLY_INCOMPLETE_SOURCE / UNKNOWN_SOURCE_COMPLETENESS and TRUNCATED_SOURCE forces failureReason SOURCE_CONTEXT_TRUNCATED (never COMPLETED).
dependencyRemediation: Per 06 R-3/R-4/R-5: query-side reference normalization + enclosing-node fallback + degenerate-occurrence exclusion in a new resolver used by source-context.ts and by semantic/tools.ts's getReferencedProvision; IRRule.unresolvedDependencies (additive) replaces the silent drop in normalize.ts; a generic shared-cap instruction and synthetic example are added to the composition prompt.
whatIsDeliberatelyNotChanged: IRExpression node kinds, type-check.ts, validate.ts semantics (only additive optional fields on interfaces)
context-retrieval/pipeline.ts budget order (the new source-context layer supplies explicit cross-references independently rather than re-tuning Phase 2D)
runToRunStability: Section 27: inventoryItemId is content-derived from (candidateRef, semanticRole, verbatim source span start/end, normalized quantitative values) - never from the model's free-text proposition - so the SAME source component inventoried in two independent runs receives the SAME id when the model anchors it to the same span; the stability comparator (scripts only) additionally matches by role + overlapping span so a slightly different excerpt boundary still pairs. Inventory variance (Pass A) and composition variance (Pass B/C disposition of the same item) are reported separately.
expectedCostShape: One additional schema-forced Pass A call per unit (source + expanded context in, a flat inventory out) plus a larger Pass B first turn (frozen inventory appended). Estimated +35-50% per unit over Mission 4's per-region cost; two executions of both validations are required (Section 27), so the total materially exceeds $12 and authorization is requested at the freeze point (11-provider-cost-plan.json).
